nodes.summary: A rank-one operator has finite range.
nodes.title: Rank-one operators have finite range

nodes.summary: Adding a finite-rank operator does not change the Fredholm index. The proof follows the segment `T + t • F`, `t ∈ [0, 1]`, which is a continuous path of Fredholm operators.
nodes.title: Finite-rank perturbation preserves the Fredholm index

nodes.summary: The Fredholm index is constant along a continuous path of Fredholm operators on `[0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Fredholm index is constant along a path continuous on (0, 1)

nodes.summary: The Fredholm index is constant along a globally continuous path of Fredholm operators on `[0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Fredholm index is constant along a globally continuous path

nodes.summary: The Fredholm index is constant along a continuous family of Fredholm operators indexed by a preconnected set, because the index is locally constant (Mathlib) and takes values in the discrete space `ℤ`.
nodes.title: Fredholm index is constant on preconnected families

nodes.summary: Adding a finite-rank operator on the left does not change the Fredholm index.
nodes.title: Left finite-rank perturbation preserves the Fredholm index

nodes.summary: Subtracting a finite-rank operator does not change the Fredholm index.
nodes.title: Subtracting a finite-rank operator preserves the Fredholm index

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
